name: creality-multimaterial-openvcad
description: Creality MultiMaterial Studio integration for OpenVCAD volumetric designs. Features: OpenVCAD project file support (.vcad, .py, .json), multi-material configuration for volumetric regions, 3MF file export for Creality Print, support for PLA/ABS/TPU/PETG materials, command-line interface, volumetric and voxel-based design support, and functionally graded material structures.
author: thewriterben
